> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.1.1 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This release prepares People Atlas for distribution through the Obsidian Community Plugins directory. It adds explicit privacy and data-access disclosures, aligns metadata and command labels with the review guidelines, and introduces an automated community-readiness gate.
